description: This file defines the LanguageDao class, which provides data access methods for CRUD operations and queries related to Language entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, listing, counting, and deleting language records, as well as checking for existing language names.

classes.name: LanguageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing Language entities, providing CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Persists a Language entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its ID, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns an array of IDs that exist in the database from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity matching the given name.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Returns a list of Language entities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a Paginator object for paginating language search results.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of Language entities matching search filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteLanguages
methods.description: Deletes multiple Language entities by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks whether a language name already exists in the database.
